== Airlines and destinations ==
===Key destinations===
In 2024, the [[International Air Transport Association]] reported that the Manila–[[Cebu]] corridor was the busiest passenger flight route from Manila and the [[List of busiest passenger flight routes|eighth-busiest in the world]] by total passenger traffic. Cebu was also the most frequently served destination from Manila in terms of flight frequency, followed by [[Caticlan]], [[Iloilo]], [[Davao Region|Davao]], [[Cagayan de Oro]], and [[Bacolod]].

In summer 2025, [[OAG (company)|OAG]] reported that Manila–[[Singapore]] was the sixth-busiest international passenger flight route in Southeast Asia and the busiest international route from Manila, with 1,459,007 seats available that year. In terms of flight frequency, however, [[Hong Kong]] was the most served international destination from NAIA, followed by Singapore, [[Taipei]], [[Seoul]], [[Tokyo]] ([[Narita International Airport|Narita]]), and [[Kuala Lumpur]].
